situation.estimate: Founded in 2022 by Guy Weiss (CEO, ex-StuccoMedia), Noam Neumann (COO) and Jonatan Bien (CTO). Zenzap ran for years as a mobile-first 'professional work chat app' for frontline and SMB teams (WhatsApp/Slack replacement), sold PLG plus sales-led, and claims 10,500+ teams. It closed an $11M seed in 2022 and a $33M Series A (Bessemer + Lightspeed co-lead, The Garage) in Aug 2025, but only announced it on Oct 14, 2026, framed as 'emerging from stealth'. At the same moment it repositioned around 'collaborative / multiplayer AI agents for work': the WordPress site was rebuilt around Sept 2026 (previously Webflow), the homepage moved from 'Work Chat Built for the AI Era' (May 2026) to 'AI Agents for Work', and blog topics switched to agents from Sept 2026. It has about 45 employees (Calcalist) across Tel Aviv, the US (LinkedIn HQ: New York) and Europe, with a formed marketing team. The direction is a category move from team chat into AI agents/workflows, competing for 'AI agents for teams' answers against Slack AI, Teams Copilot and agent startups, while its large content archive still talks chat apps.

trigger.detail: $33M Series A co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with The Garage; $44M total including an $11M 2022 seed. Calcalist (primary/reputable) states the Series A 'closed in August 2025'. It was publicly announced Oct 14, 2026 (Calcalist, TechCrunch; company About page: 'In October 2026, Zenzap emerged from stealth'), together with a repositioning to AI agents for work. The public milestone is fresh (5 weeks); the money itself is 15 months old. Reference the announcement, not 'just raised'. TechCrunch headlines the $44M total, and some aggregators wrongly add the two figures to $77M.
